final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 2, object 4]; rule=the device turns on when objects 1, 2, and 4 are all present together.
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 5, object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3]; rule=the device turns on if all six objects are present.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=The device turns on only when all objects are placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6]; rule=The device turns on only when all seven relevant objects (excluding object 7) are placed together.
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=The device turns on if object 3, object 4, and object 5 are all placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=The device turns on when exactly seven objects are placed, regardless of which ones.
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 5, object 7]; rule=The device turns on if object 4, object 5, and object 7 are placed on it.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4]; rule=The device turns on when at least objects 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 are placed on it. Other objects may also be included.
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 3, object 5]; rule=The device turns on only when object 2, object 3, and object 5 are all included in the set placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=The device turns on only when all objects are placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=The device turns on only when all objects are placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=The device turns on when object 0, object 1, and object 2 are all placed together.
